requested_visible_change: Keep the homepage Hero coherent in a narrowed Mac browser window and remove equivalent responsive failures across every site page.
expected_visible_delta: The Hero remains one viewport-high composition with its headline, description and split CTA inside the screen from 480 through 1199 px; the privacy heading no longer creates horizontal overflow.

target.state: public pages at scrollY=0 with native Hero video/poster and default privacy content
target.action: fresh-load each exact viewport; click the Hero scenario CTA and confirm #plan-delivery-popup

must_remain_unchanged: Hero scenario CTA copy and popup behavior
